Experimental Design is a three-page article by Leslee A Kulba , published in 2010 in issue 48 of the Electric Spacecraft Journal , the journal's final double issue. It is the fifth part of the ten-part handbook on perpetual motion and its testing that Kulba, the journal's technical editor, contributed to that issue, and it begins the practical half: having described the machines and the principles, the remaining six articles are about how to find out.
The text of the article has not been recoverable, and this page describes its subject and its place in the series rather than its argument.
The subject
The ordinary requirements
An experiment is a question put in a form that can be answered wrongly. The requirements are the familiar ones and they are not negotiable by subject matter: state in advance what result would count as confirming and what would count as refuting; change one variable at a time; run a control — the same apparatus with the effect deliberately disabled — and check that it gives the null result; record the conditions, not only the readings; and have someone else repeat it with their own equipment.
The last is the one that matters most and is skipped most often. A result that only appears in one shed, on one bench, with one person present, is not yet a result. Independent replication is what distinguishes a discovery from a fault in a particular set-up, and it is unforgiving precisely because the apparatus that produced the anomaly does not travel with it.

The magazine is not peer reviewed , and it does not present itself as such. From the Archives of Lester J. Hendershot is a 1995 book compiled and self-published by Mark M. Hendershot from the personal papers of his father, the inventor Lester J. Hendershot (1898–1961). It gathers documents, notes, correspondence and photographs relating to the Hendershot fuelless generator — the "magnetic motor" that made Lester Hendershot briefly famous in 1928 — and is one of the principal source collections on the device and the controversy surrounding it.
Overview
Drawing on material Lester Hendershot left behind, the book documents the origin of the fuelless generator (which Hendershot said he stumbled upon while developing a fuelless aviation compass), its public unveiling and the intense press attention it drew, the interest of prominent backers, and the political and commercial difficulties that eventually caused Hendershot to set the work aside. As a first-hand family compilation rather than an independent technical study, it preserves primary material — letters, diagrams and recollections — that would otherwise have been lost, and it remains a key reference within the free-energy community. The device's operation has never been independently verified, and its claimed fuelless output is not accepted by mainstream science.
In the book's introduction Mark Hendershot writes:
"My name is Mark Hendershot; Lester J. Hendershot was my father. Lester was an inventor, and in his many attempts at producing practical items he had moderate success a few times with electronic toys and sold some of his ideas to small manufacturers. How Peace Activists Can Be More Effective is an article by Buryl Payne arguing that peace activism could be made more effective by taking account of what he describes as the cyclic, externally-triggered nature of war, and by the deliberate use of collective "thought power." The claims below are the author's own and are not accepted by the scientific mainstream.
Peace activities are all too often reactive rather than proactive. Only after an international battle or war has occurred are attempts made to ameliorate situations by constructing treaties, agreements, or the curtailment of nuclear weapons, cluster bombs, poison gas, biological weapons, and so on. This is political symptom treatment. Historical analysis shows this approach is only partially successful: when wars start up again, peace treaties go out the window. Effective treatment of warring behavior may be aided by a more modern understanding of the nature of war.
Section I. Wars come and go in cycles
Warring behavior can be considered as a kind of mass psychosis — insane behavior. Individuals who behave that way are locked up and treated by psychiatrists.
The most important finding of scientists, based on observations rather than theories, is that wars come and go in cycles. These cycles were discovered by the late Professor Raymond Wheeler, a psychologist and historian at the University of Kansas. As part of his larger historical analysis he found that international battles happen in approximately 11-year cycles, and have done so for 2,500 years. His work was later statistically validated by Edward Dewey, Director of the Foundation for the Study of Cycles, who considered the analysis of war cycles the most important work of his life. A portion of Wheeler's data on war cycles was presented in the article as Figure 1 (an 11⅕-year cycle in international battles, 1760–1947).

The two founded Jupiter-Verlag in 1987 and ITEC in 1998, and since December 1996 have jointly edited and published the NET-Journal , the main German-language periodical devoted to new energy technologies.

She wrote the booklet No More Silent Observation for the Swiss physicians' association against vivisection, and published the children's book Goldkater Leo (1975) and Countdown Apokalypse (1995) through Jupiter-Verlag. Introduction to Error Analysis & Interpretation is a three-page article by Leslee A Kulba , published in 2010 in issue 48 of the Electric Spacecraft Journal , the journal's final double issue. It is the tenth and last part of the handbook on perpetual motion and its testing that Kulba, the journal's technical editor, contributed to that issue, and it closes both the practical sequence and the journal itself.
The text of the article has not been recoverable, and this page describes its subject and its place in the series rather than its argument.
The subject
Two kinds of error
Random errors scatter repeated readings around a value; they are reduced by averaging, and the scatter itself estimates them. Systematic errors displace every reading in the same direction; averaging does nothing to them, they leave no trace in the scatter, and they are found only by changing something about the method — a different instrument, a different technique, a different laboratory. A result can therefore be highly precise and entirely wrong, and the whole of the preceding series is concerned with sources of the second kind: probe loading, average-responding meters, thermoelectric offsets, mismatch, apparent power read as real.
Propagating uncertainty
An uncertainty on a measured quantity implies an uncertainty on anything computed from it. For a sum or difference the absolute uncertainties combine in quadrature; for a product or quotient the relative ones do. Only the first of these is peculiar to this subject, and it is peculiar in a way that matters a great deal.

Jean-Louis Naudin is a French experimenter who, through his laboratory website JLN Labs ( jnaudin.free.fr ), carried out and documented what is probably the largest single body of replication work in alternative science. Where most of the literature catalogued on this wiki consists of theory, Naudin's contribution is almost entirely practical: he built other people's devices, measured them, and published the results — including the negative ones.
Method
What distinguishes Naudin's work from most amateur replication is its openness . For each project he published construction drawings, parts lists, circuit diagrams, oscilloscope traces, photographs and video, in enough detail that a reader with a workbench could repeat the experiment and get the same numbers. He also maintained the practice of publishing when a device failed to perform as claimed , which is uncommon in this field and is the reason his measurements were taken seriously by people who did not share his interpretations.
That openness had a consequence he may not have intended but which is to his credit: by putting a device into hundreds of hands with reproducible instructions, he made it possible for a claim to be settled rather than merely argued about. The Lifter is the clearest case.
The Lifter experiments
Naudin's best-known work is the Lifter — a lightweight triangular frame carrying an asymmetric capacitor, a thin wire electrode above a wider foil skirt, energised at tens of kilovolts. It rises silently, with no moving parts, lifting its own weight and a payload on electrical power alone.

Johann Marinsek (correctly spelled Marinšek , pronounced "Marinshek") is an Austrian physicist , engineer and independent author whose work addresses the ontological and conceptual foundations of physics, including the nature of matter, inertia, radiation and atomic structure. A retired assistant professor of mechanics at Graz University of Technology , he is a critic of the theory of relativity , of quantum physics and of the Rutherford–Bohr atomic model, and has proposed an alternative model of matter based on elementary permanent ring magnets.
Biography
Marinsek trained as a civil engineer at the Technical University in Graz, Austria, and served for twenty years as an assistant professor at the university's Institute for Mechanics. Alongside that post he studied philosophy and the history of science, an interest reflected in the historical treatment of inertia, categories and natural philosophy that runs through his later writing. He subsequently worked as an independent private scholar. He resides in Deutschlandsberg, in the Austrian state of Styria.
Education
Civil engineering — Technical University in Graz (now Graz University of Technology ), Austria
Philosophy and history of science — studied during his twenty years at the university's Institute for Mechanics
Scientific contributions
Marinsek's research concerns the ontological foundations of physics, that is, the nature of its basic concepts such as movement, space, force, charge and quantity of matter, as well as the derived concepts of time and energy and the nature of inert mass. He argues that a number of accepted results in modern physics rest on what he regards as category mistakes, and he examines the axiomatic basis of mechanics, relativity theory and quantum physics.

John Balfour is a researcher and advocate of community-scale solar electricity who argued, at the independent-energy conferences of the early 2000s, that ordinary residential developments could be designed and built to generate all of their own electricity and so free their residents from utility bills altogether. Very little about him is documented in publicly accessible sources, and this article is deliberately limited to what those sources support.

No source consulted establishes that he and the 2004 conference speaker are the same person, and the two are therefore treated separately here.
Scientific contributions
Balfour's contribution to the independent-energy community was to shift attention from the single self-sufficient house to the self-sufficient community . José Luis López-Bonilla is a Mexican mathematical physicist at the Escuela Superior de Ingeniería Mecánica y Eléctrica (ESIME) of the Instituto Politécnico Nacional in Mexico City, in its Sección de Estudios de Posgrado e Investigación. He is a prolific and long-standing contributor to the technical literature of general relativity and mathematical methods, usually publishing with collaborators and students.
Work
His output is unusually broad for a specialist, and falls into several distinct strands.
The Lanczos potential and general relativity
His most sustained subject is the Lanczos potential — a third-rank spin tensor introduced by Cornelius Lanczos in 1962 that generates the Weyl conformal tensor, playing a role for gravitation loosely analogous to that of the vector potential in electromagnetism. López-Bonilla has published constructions of it for particular spacetimes, including Lanczos Spintensor for the Gödel Metric and A Potential for the Lanczos Spintensor in Kerr Geometry (both 1999), and the associated Lanczos scalars recur throughout his work on the geometry of spacetime.
Embedding of spacetimes
A related strand concerns the local isometric embedding of a four-dimensional spacetime in a flat higher-dimensional space. A Necessary Algebraic Condition for R4 Embedded into E5 ( Apeiron , 2005) derives a purely intrinsic algebraic condition that any spacetime of embedding class one must satisfy, intended as a screening test to be applied before attempting to construct the second fundamental form.
Classical electrodynamics and antennas
He has also published on the Liénard–Wiechert field of an accelerated charge, on quaternionic formulations of Maxwell's equations and the Lorentz transformation, and — reflecting the engineering setting of ESIME — on the numerical analysis of circular and cross antennas.

Jovan Marjanović is a Serbian electrical engineer (B.Sc.) based in Novi Sad, and the principal theoretical writer associated with the Veljko Milković Research & Development Center. Where Milković is an inventor and builder, Marjanović's role has been to supply mathematical analysis of the devices and to argue for the physical principles they are held to demonstrate.
Work
His papers, listed below, form a connected series running from 2007 to 2011, and they are all concerned with the same question: whether a mechanical or electromechanical arrangement can return more energy than is put into it.
The earliest, Keys of Understanding Gravity Machines of Veljko Milković (2007), analyses Milković's two-stage mechanical oscillator — a heavy pendulum whose pivot carries a lever arm, so that the swinging bob drives the lever. The claim associated with the device is that the work recovered at the lever exceeds the work needed to keep the pendulum swinging. Marjanović's Mechanical Feedback Loop Problems (2008) addresses the obvious follow-on question, namely why the device has never been made to sustain itself, and proposes solutions.
A second thread concerns electromagnetism. Karin Westdyk is an American writer on environmental and energy subjects, best known within the new energy community for documenting the work of the hydrogen inventor Francisco Pacheco . She is a writer rather than a scientist, and her two pieces catalogued here are works of journalism — a magazine article and a book chapter — rather than technical papers.
Writing
Westdyk's account of Pacheco appeared in two places:
" US Patent Granted to West Milford Resident for Unique Hydrogen Energy Systems " ( The Messenger: Environmental Health Journal , March/April 1992) — a report, from Pacheco's own New Jersey area, on the granting of his 1992 US patent.
" The Story of Francisco Pacheco and the Suppression of Hydrogen Technology " (1994) — a chapter in the anthology Suppressed Inventions and Other Discoveries , which frames Pacheco's device within that book's theme of technologies allegedly kept from the public.
Subject: Francisco Pacheco and his hydrogen generator
Francisco Pacheco (a Bolivian-born inventor based at Hewitt, in the West Milford area of New Jersey) built and patented a "Bi-Polar Autoelectric Hydrogen Generator" — US Patent 3,892,653 (1975) and later US 5,089,107 (1992), with corresponding patents in Germany, Brazil and Japan. The device generates hydrogen from seawater using a galvanic cell: sacrificial magnesium and aluminium plates as the anode, stainless steel as the cathode, and seawater as the electrolyte, producing hydrogen both by electrolytic action at the cathode and by chemical reaction at the anode.

Keely's Musical Dynasphere is a 21-page booklet of 1989 by Dale Pond , published by his own imprint Delta Spectrum Research. It is a documentary compilation rather than an argument: it assembles John Ernst Worrell Keely's own descriptions of how his rotating "musical dynaspheres" were built and operated, together with eyewitness accounts of the machines running, photographs and illustrations.
What the booklet contains
The material is presented largely in Keely's own language , which is part of the point — his vocabulary of sympathetic vibration, etheric force, and the "vibrating aggregate" is idiosyncratic enough that paraphrase loses it. Several pages are given to testimony from witnesses who reported seeing the motors run, which is the strongest evidence Keely's supporters had then and have now.
The dynasphere itself was one of a series of rotating spheres Keely built in Philadelphia from the 1870s, which he said were driven by sympathetic vibration — resonance between the machine and a surrounding medium — rather than by any conventional source of power.
John Keely and the Keely Motor Company
John Ernst Worrell Keely (3 September 1837 – 18 November 1898) founded the Keely Motor Company in Philadelphia in 1875 to develop and commercialise a "vibratory generator" which he claimed could produce, from a quart of water, the power to haul a loaded train. He raised money from some three thousand shareholders over more than two decades, and was supported for years by the wealthy Philadelphia patroness Clara Bloomfield-Moore.

Abstract
A method is disclosed to fabricate a Palladium cathode that can be electrolyzed in heavy water and stimulated with a laser at a predetermined wavelength to produce apparent excess power; the fabrication method involves cold working, polishing, etching and annealing the Palladium prior to electrolytic loading with Deuterium. Loading is accomplished with the cathode sitting in a magnetic field of 350 Gauss. After loading the cathode with Deuterium, Gold is co-deposited electrolytically on the cathode. When a coating of Gold is visible on the cathode, co-deposition is halted and the cathode is stimulated with a low-power laser with a maximum power of 30 milliwatts. The thermal response of the cathode is typically 500 mW with maximum output observed of approximately 1 watt. The effect is repeatable when protocols are followed and has been demonstrated in several laboratories.

Dennis Letts and Dennis Cravens describe a protocol for producing apparent excess power from a palladium cathode electrolysed in heavy water and illuminated by a low-power laser, presented at the Tenth International Conference on Cold Fusion in 2003.

Gold is then co-deposited electrolytically onto the cathode, and the co-deposition is halted once a gold coating is visible.
The stimulation is optical. The prepared cathode is illuminated with a low-power laser of at most 30 milliwatts, at a wavelength the authors describe as predetermined. The reported thermal response is typically 500 mW, with a maximum observed output of about 1 watt.

Lester Jennings Hendershot (3 June 1898 – 19 April 1961) was an American inventor , best known for the so-called Hendershot fuelless generator (or "Fuelless Motor"), a device he unveiled in 1928 that he claimed produced electrical power without any fuel. The invention drew national press attention and the interest of prominent backers before commercial and political difficulties led Hendershot to abandon it. Its operation was never explained or independently verified, and its claimed fuelless output is not accepted by mainstream science.
Education

Biography
Lester Hendershot was born on 3 June 1898 in West Elizabeth, Pennsylvania. He had little formal education and was largely self-taught as an inventor, achieving modest success with electronic toys and selling some of his ideas to small manufacturers.

He developed this into what he called a "magnetic induction" motor, first announced in March 1928. The device — quickly dubbed a "fuelless motor" by the press — attracted intense publicity and the attention of well-known figures, including Major Thomas Lanphier, commandant at Selfridge Field, and Henry Breckinridge, the attorney for Colonel Charles Lindbergh, who was among those said to have taken an interest in the invention.

Marko Rodin is an American independent researcher and inventor, the originator of Vortex-Based Mathematics (VBM) and of the toroidal winding pattern known as the Rodin coil . The coil is among the most widely replicated devices in the amateur new energy community, and a substantial body of experimental reports on it is catalogued on this wiki.
Origin of Vortex-Based Mathematics
By Rodin's own account, the number system did not begin as a physics investigation but as a religious inquiry . Raised in the Bahá'í Faith , he set out to find what he took to be the precise mystical significance of the Most Great Name of God, and converted its superlative form Abhá into numbers using the Abjad system, in which each letter of the Arabic alphabet carries a numerical value. Taking A = 1, b = 2, h = 5, á = 1, the letters sum to 9 — a number given repeated significance in Bahá'í scripture. From that starting point he developed the patterns he came to call Vortex-Based Mathematics.
This origin is worth stating plainly because it explains the structure of the system, which is organised throughout around the number 9 and around digit sums. It should also be said that VBM is not Bahá'í doctrine and carries no standing within that religion, which cautions against numerology.
Vortex-Based Mathematics
The system works in modulo-9 arithmetic : every number is reduced by repeatedly summing its digits until a single value from 1 to 9 remains. Two features are then treated as fundamental.
The first is the doubling sequence . Repeatedly doubling and reducing gives 1 → 2 → 4 → 8 → 7 (16) → 5 (32) → 1 (64), a closed six-step loop; halving traverses the same loop in reverse. Rodin identifies this circuit with what he calls "the longest free-flowing path of the electron", and the coil is wound to follow it.

Matti Juhani Pitkänen (born 30 October 1950, in Kiuruvesi, Finland) is a Finnish theoretical physicist. He has worked for most of his career as an independent researcher and lives in Hanko, a small seaside town in southern Finland.
Biography
Pitkänen began studying physics, theoretical physics, and mathematics at the University of Helsinki in 1970. He completed the degree of Candidate of Philosophy in theoretical physics in 1977 and the degree of Licentiate of Philosophy in theoretical physics in 1982. He received his Ph.D. in theoretical physics from the University of Helsinki in 1982 with a thesis titled Topological Geometrodynamics .
During and after his studies he held a series of academic and research positions, including assistant posts in the Department of Theoretical Physics (1976–1979), a research assistantship at the Helsinki University of Technology (1980–1981), a research post at the Neste Oy research center (1984–1985), a teaching position in the Department of Theoretical Physics (1987–1992), and a research position in the Division of High Energy Physics at the University of Helsinki (1996–1997). Since completing his thesis he has continued to develop TGD largely as a self-described "free researcher" outside a permanent university appointment.
Pitkänen has four children. He has said that his research program has been the central passion of his life for several decades.

He describes himself as "an inventor, visionary artist, metaphysical scientist and inter-dimensional explorer," and is the developer of the Magnevex motor/generator and head of the Magnevex Research Project. Leas's use of the phrase is drawn from Tesla's own writing on wireless power and should be distinguished from the Electric Universe plasma-cosmology programme associated with Wallace Thornhill and David Talbott; the sources for his talks do not connect him to that body of work.

The Space Energy Association
The Space Energy Association (SEA) operated from Post Office Box 1136, Clearwater, Florida, and its leading figure was Donald A. Kelly . It described itself as existing "to offer top quality free energy information to our membership," and it issued two publications:
the Space Energy Newsletter , in circulation by December 1993
the Space Energy Journal , a quarterly, running through at least 1996 and still taking subscriptions in 1998
The Journal was dedicated, in its own words, to the work of Nikola Tesla, Victor Schauberger, T. Henry Moray, T. J. J. See, Alfred Hubbard, Erwin Saxl and Hans Coler. Its editorial policy was unusually explicit about where it stood: unlike "some other alternate energy journals," it intended "to endorse and support free energy units and systems which show a positive test and track record," publishing construction plans and putting members in touch with the inventors, while disclaiming liability for patent infringement and for injury during construction.
The association was not merely a publisher. It undertook at least one construction project of its own, a prototype of the Swiss M-L converter — the electrostatic machine developed by Paul Baumann at the Methernitha community, a development of the Wimshurst generator.

Abstract
Two mechanisms utilized to explain the operation of railguns are explained: one based on Ampere's force and the other on the transfer of momentum through electromagnetic waves. It is shown how the former is compatible with the data while the latter has problems with the quantitative figures and the case of the immobilized projectile.
Overview
On the Mechanism of Railguns is a three-page paper by Andre K T Assis of the Department of Cosmic Rays and Chronology at the State University of Campinas, published in Galilean Electrodynamics volume 3, number 5 (September/October 1992), pages 93–95.
It compares two accounts of what accelerates a railgun projectile. In a railgun, current from a source flows out along one fixed rail, across a conducting projectile bridging the rails, and back along the other; a ponderomotive force drives the projectile along the rails. Assis asks where that force comes from.
The first candidate is Ampère's force law, the 1820s expression for the force between two current elements, which he gives as his equation (1). The second, advanced by Pappas and others, is that momentum is transferred by the reflection of electromagnetic waves from the projectile, with a backward-propagating radiation field carrying the recoil.
Assis argues for the first on three grounds. Ampère's law satisfies Newton's third law "in the strongest form," so that a closed circuit cannot exert a net force on itself — consistent with the fact that no experiment has demonstrated such a bootstrap effect in metallic circuits. Perpetual Motion: The History of an Obsession is a history of perpetual-motion machines and the people who built them, by the English mechanical and aeronautical engineer Arthur W J G Ord-Hume . First published by George Allen & Unwin in London in 1977 , with 235 pages and 95 illustrations, it has stayed in print through several reissues and is generally treated as the standard work on its subject.
It is an unusual entry in this collection, because it is a sceptical book. Ord-Hume's subject is a four-century record of failure, and his thesis is that the failures mattered: "without their early experiments the science of mechanics would not have developed so rapidly."
The argument
The book takes the proposition at its plainest — "make a machine which gives out more work than the energy you put into it and you have perpetual motion" — and follows its pursuit from the medieval overbalancing wheel to the twentieth century.
Two threads run through it. The first is how the impossibility was established : the attempts, and the increasingly precise reasons for their failure, are part of how mechanics arrived at the conservation laws. The inventors were, in Ord-Hume's account, the unwitting experimental arm of a science that had not yet been formulated, and the basic tenets of engineering grew out of their defeats .
The second is the character of the pursuit, which the subtitle names. Ord-Hume is interested in why the problem grips people — and he distinguishes carefully between the self-deceived, the merely mistaken, and the outright frauds , of whom there were many. The tone is neither credulous nor contemptuous.

Peter Glück (Péter Gluck) was a Romanian chemical engineer based in Cluj who became one of the most prolific and outspoken commentators on cold fusion and low-energy nuclear reactions (LENR). Through his long-running blog "Ego Out" and his contributions to Infinite Energy magazine, he chronicled and critiqued the field for more than three decades, arguing that cold fusion represented a genuine but badly mismanaged path to a new energy source. He died on 23 March 2021 at the age of 83.
Biography
Glück was a chemical engineer by training and profession, with a career spent in the Romanian chemical industry, working out of Cluj. He often invoked his hands-on plant experience in his writing, describing himself as a practical "technologist" rather than an academic theorist. He followed the cold fusion field from close to its beginnings after the 1989 Fleischmann–Pons announcement, and remained an active participant in the online LENR community until shortly before his death, on 23 March 2021 — the anniversary of the Fleischmann–Pons announcement — at the age of 83.
Work
Glück's principal platform was his blog Ego Out , where he published near-daily commentary on the history, politics and technical direction of cold fusion and LENR. He also wrote numerous articles for Infinite Energy magazine and, according to the magazine, served on its Scientific Advisory Board from 1995 until his death.
His outlook combined dissident optimism with sharp internal criticism of the field. He argued that classic palladium–deuterium and nickel–hydrogen cold fusion research had reached a dead end, and distinguished it from what he called "LENR+" — the higher-output, commercially oriented systems he associated with Andrea Rossi's E-Cat and with Defkalion — which he viewed as the field's real future. Peter Grandics is a Hungarian-born chemical and biochemical engineer based in Carlsbad, California, who has worked in biomedical research and, more recently, on atmospheric energy harvesting.
Education
MS in chemical engineering
PhD in biochemical engineering
Work
Grandics spent most of his career in biomedical research and bioseparation technology before turning to energy. His 2007 paper " The Pyramidal Electric Transducer ", published in Infinite Energy , proposes that the global atmospheric electric circuit could be tapped for commercial power by a conducting pyramid acting as a wideband antenna for electrostatic discharge impulses, coupled to a lumped-element resonant circuit that converts random impulses into damped sinusoidal wave trains.
The paper combines bench measurements — swept-signal analyses of the coil system, differential measurements of energy transfer between primary and secondary windings, and discharge trains driven by a laboratory Van de Graaff generator — with an argument that the dimensional ratios of the Great Pyramid of Giza encode both sine-wave parameters and the golden ratio, and that the structure may therefore have been designed as an antenna. He holds patents on the transducer design and presented the work at the ExtraOrdinary Technology Conference in 2009.
The engineering claim rests on the available power in the atmospheric circuit, which is the point on which it is usually assessed: the global circuit carries roughly a kiloampere at about 250 kV, a total of some 250 megawatts spread over the whole Earth.

The second is the "Beck Protocol" , a set of self-administered electrical and chemical health procedures he devised and promoted from the early 1990s, centred on passing microcurrents through the body and on home-made ionic colloidal silver. These he presented as treatments for a wide range of infectious disease including HIV. No part of the protocol has been shown by controlled clinical trial to treat any disease , and the colloidal silver component carries documented harms; see Medical assessment below.

Roberto Blas is an Argentine physicist at the Universidad Nacional de Río Cuarto in Córdoba, working on the electrodynamics of homopolar machines.
His published work is a collaboration with Jorge A Guala-Valverde of the Fundación Julio Palacios in Neuquén, and in most cases with Max Blas as a third author. The programme is experimental: it uses Faraday-disc and homopolar motor-generator arrangements to ask what determines the electromotive force in a rotating magnetic system — motion relative to the magnet, relative to the field-shaping iron, or relative to the laboratory. The group's distinctive apparatus is the "confined B-field" machine described in Non-Local Motional EM Induction (2005), in which an iron yoke channels a rotatable magnet's flux into a narrow air gap, so that magnet, yoke and coil can each be held or spun independently.
The interpretation the group favours is a relational one drawing on Weber electrodynamics and on Amperian surface currents, and the same theme runs through their other papers: "Inertial Mass: a Changing Entity? Weber vs. Einstein, Weber Plus Einstein or None?" (2005), "Maxwell Helps Explain Microphysics" (2002), and "Non-Local Motional Electrodynamics" (2009). Guala-Valverde's related work on homopolar induction has also appeared in the American Journal of Physics and Physica Scripta .

It stands for a series of articles by the Austrian naturalist and inventor Viktor Schauberger (1885–1958) that were translated from German and republished in the Causes newsletter between 1988 and 1991, the translation credited on this wiki to Walter P. Baumgartner .
The entry carries no individual title, volume, issue or page numbers, because it does not correspond to one publication. It is best read as a pointer to a body of translated material rather than as a citation.
Abstract
Several of Viktor Schauberger's articles were translated and republished in Causes newsletter from 1988 to 1991.
What the record stands for
Schauberger wrote in German and published very little in English during his lifetime. The English-speaking alternative-energy community of the 1970s and 1980s therefore depended on a small number of translators, and this record marks one of those efforts.
The World Science Database entry (abstract record 3867) gives the year as 1988 and the journal as Causes , with no volume, page range or article titles. The 1988–1991 span comes from the abstract text itself rather than from any bibliographic field, so the single date shown in most listings understates the series.
The Causes newsletter
Causes was a small-circulation newsletter published from Albuquerque, New Mexico , the city the World Science Database gives as Baumgartner's own. It is not held by the major library catalogues and no run of it was located for this article; what is known of its contents comes from citations in later Schauberger literature.

Shiuji Inomata (1932 – 17 April 2001), also romanised Shuji Inomata , was a Japanese physicist and engineer, president of the Japan Psychotronics Institute , and a leading figure in the Japanese "new-paradigm science" and free-energy movements. He is known for his work on the N-machine — a homopolar "free-energy" generator — and for a speculative theory that sought to write consciousness into the equations of physics as a third term alongside energy and matter. He is listed in Jean de Climont 's Worldwide List of Dissident Scientists .
Biography
Inomata graduated in physics and engineering from the University of Electro-Communications in Tokyo and took a Ph.D. from the Tokyo Institute of Technology . He worked as a postdoctoral researcher at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and spent much of his career as a government scientist in Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), at its Electrotechnical Laboratory.
From that position he became an organiser as much as a researcher. He founded and led the Japan Psychotronics Institute , through which in the 1990s he hosted several international symposia on "new-paradigm science," including one at Waseda University in Tokyo, and he launched a committee within MITI to investigate "new energy," which he associated with the traditional concept of ki . He died on 17 April 2001 in a hospital near his home in Niigata, of organ failure associated with liver cancer, at the age of sixty-eight.

Stanley Allen Meyer (24 August 1940 – 20 March 1998) was an American independent inventor from Grove City, Ohio, known for the Water Fuel Cell — a device he said could split water into hydrogen and oxygen using far less electrical energy than conventional electrolysis requires, so that a vehicle could run on water alone. He fitted the apparatus to a dune buggy, demonstrated it publicly from 1986 onwards, and held a series of United States patents on the components.
Meyer's claim was that the cell dissociated water not by brute-force current but by voltage — a high-voltage pulse train applied to a resonant cavity, drawing negligible current. He called the sequence the Hydrogen Fracturing Process . If it worked as described, the energy released by burning the resulting gas would exceed the energy used to produce it, which is why the claim attracted both wide attention and the flat rejection of the physics community.
In 1996 an Ohio court, hearing a suit brought by two investors, found that the cell was performing ordinary electrolysis and ruled that Meyer had committed "gross and egregious fraud". He died two years later, at 57, of a ruptured cerebral aneurysm; his reported dying words — "they poisoned me" — have kept the circumstances in dispute among his supporters ever since, though the coroner's finding and a three-month police investigation found no evidence of foul play.

The book gathers Smith's later ideas on what he called "the new science" — a framework built around fields, "tensor beams," and the manipulation of magnetism and gravity. He describes concepts such as stacking multiple tensor beams by reversing magnetic polarity, and relates his ideas to the propulsion and field phenomena he had investigated. The work grew out of Smith's government research on geomagnetism and unconventional propulsion.
About the author
Wilbert Brockhouse Smith (1910–1962) was a Canadian electrical/radio engineer with Transport Canada. He is best known for directing Project Magnet (1950–1954), an official Canadian study of geomagnetism and possible magnetic propulsion (and of UFO reports), operated from a station at Shirley's Bay near Ottawa.

The Philosopher's Stone: Alchemy and the Secret Research for Exotic Matter is a 2009 book by Joseph P Farrell , published by Feral House. It was Farrell's first book with that publisher; his earlier work appeared chiefly through Adventures Unlimited Press.
Overview
The book argues for a continuity between the aims of historical alchemy and certain strands of twentieth-century physics, on the premise that both were concerned with altering the constitution of matter itself rather than merely rearranging it. Farrell's method throughout is to read alchemical texts as descriptions of a physical medium, and then to look for modern counterparts to what he takes them to describe.
Three lines of material are drawn together. The first is the claim, associated with David Hudson, that the platinum-group metals can exist in a monatomic or "high spin" state with anomalous properties — the substance often called monatomic gold. The second is Soviet and Russian work, principally that of the astrophysicist Nikolai A Kozyrev on rotation, time and what later writers termed torsion physics, together with the "red mercury" legend that circulated after the collapse of the Soviet Union. The third is Farrell's continuing subject: German wartime research, here the device known as Die Glocke ("the Bell") and the substance identified in that literature as "Serum 525," approached alongside isotope enrichment and laser work.
The Bell and the wartime material connect this book to its predecessor, Secrets of the Unified Field: The Philadelphia Experiment, The Nazi Bell, and the Discarded Theory (2008), which treats the same device in relation to Einstein's abandoned unified field theory.

Abstract
In recent years, phenomena of a universal character have been observed in solid-state physics that, as in nuclear physics and astrophysics, permit the clarification of fundamental problems of physics. Examples are the quantum Hall effect, quantum transport, the Aharanov-Bohm effect as well as 1/f noise. All these phenomena are universal, i.e. material-independent.
It will be shown in this paper that these non-homogeneous experimental phenomena can be combined in the form of an energy equation. The essential point is that the characteristic states of this equation, known as the Electron Energy Paradigm (EEP), differ only in the coupling constant [] having different powers. To facilitate interpretation of the paper is the following comprehensive discussion of the significance of the particular energy states of this paradigm. Finally, a new way will be shown of gaining a better understanding of the wave-particle duality of the electron on the basis of the EEP.

Abstract
If a physics theory is good, beautiful, correct, etc., then it would seem reasonable to expect that it would offer a good, beautiful and correct solution to the simplest of all conceivable nontrivial physics problems. Maxwell field theory does not satisfy this desideratum! The simplest of all physics problems surely is the description of a "toy" universe comprising one particle. This problem is, of course, trivial and boring; the particle just sits there. The next simplest problem, a toy universe of two, classical, charged particles, is both nontrivial and unsolved! There are, however, approximation techniques, so that practical problems can be mastered. Basically, they take it that one of the particles is a current, solve Maxwell's equations at the location of the other, apply Lorentz's force law to get the second particle's motion. Then it in turn is taken as a current, its EM fields are calculated at the position of the first, where then Lor-entz's force law gives a perturbation-correction. This is then continued back and forth until an approximation of the desired accuracy is obtained. But, to date, there is no widely-accepted closed formulation for the dynamics of such a toy universe. One central reason, it is asserted, is that there is no universal, absolute time able to serve as the variable conjugate to the Hamiltonian of the total system. A didactic example of this matter is well known as the "twin paradox". Now, this writer regards this situation as symptomatic of serious misunderstanding. If there were, in fact, no system time, then there would also be no system Hamiltonian, which in turns would mean that there would be no global conservation of energy and momentum for this toy system. He is most closely associated with the promotion of what the group calls "quantum energy" and "fuelless generator" technology.
Biography
Thrapp is the public representative of WITTS Ministries, a Christian ministry and self-described organization of engineers, scientists, and inventors. He states that he became interested in energy technology as a child and presents himself under the honorific "Sir Timothy Thrapp." He has spoken about the ministry and its stated goals in numerous audio and video interviews, including a series of "Quantum Energy" interviews and a September 2007 discussion recorded at the Water Fuel Museum.
Work
Thrapp and WITTS Ministries claim to possess and demonstrate technologies that produce usable electrical power without conventional fuel, which they describe as drawing energy from a "quantum field" or from "dominant" energy said to be present throughout the environment. The devices they promote include a so-called "Fuelless Generator" that, once started, is said to require no ongoing fuel input, along with various motors, lighting systems, and vehicles powered by the same claimed principles.
Through the ministry and its affiliated project Enlightened Technology, Thrapp has offered plans, classes, and demonstrations of these devices, and has stated an intention to bring such technology into mass production for home use. The devices and claims associated with WITTS Ministries have not been independently verified by mainstream scientific institutions, and overunity or "free energy" claims of this kind are not accepted by the established scientific community.

Troy Reed is an American inventor and machinist from Tulsa, Oklahoma, known for promoting a claimed fuelless, permanent-magnet motor and a self-recharging electric car he called the "Surge" during the late 1980s and 1990s. His devices are presented by their supporters as a form of clean, free or "new" energy, though such over-unity and self-running claims are not accepted by mainstream science.
Biography
Reed was an Oklahoma machinist who said he began developing his magnetic-motor concept after a series of ideas and visions dating back to 1959. Reports from the mid-1990s describe him as being in his late fifties at that time and having worked on the project for some 35 years. He built and demonstrated his prototypes in his own workshop in the Tulsa area. Reed's work was promoted in alternative-energy circles and was associated with the actor Dennis Weaver, described in period accounts as a collaborator on the Surge vehicle project.
Claimed magnetic motor
Reed claimed to have built a motor driven entirely by permanent magnets that consumed no fuel and produced no emissions. According to accounts of his demonstrations, an early 1989 prototype stood about seven feet tall, weighed more than 500 pounds, had four moving parts, and was said to power a 500-watt generator. He described the mechanism as a horizontal shaft carrying magnets, with spring-loaded, magnet-tipped pistons above it whose motion was claimed to sustain the shaft's rotation once started by hand crank.
Reed said later versions were much smaller — reportedly about 20 inches high and under 200 pounds — and that they could drive a 7,000-watt generator, enough, he claimed, to power an average home. He also said he had built a car called the "Surge" that used his motor technology and recharged itself while being driven rather than needing to be plugged in.

Walt Jenkins (also given as Walter P. Jenkins ) is an American independent inventor, based in Florida, who develops on-board systems intended to let internal combustion engines run largely on water. His work is marketed under the name H2G through his company H2 Global, LLC. Jenkins is a familiar figure in the independent-energy community and has been described within it as a modern successor to Stanley Meyer; his central claim is that his process is not electrolysis and does not derive from prior water-fuel art.
Biography
Jenkins came to energy research from an unrelated technical career. He has said that he worked in the motion picture industry in Hollywood during the 1970s, where he developed an early virtual set system and other computer-based production tools, and that he managed a broadcast television station in the Orlando, Florida market during the late 1990s.
He began experimenting with alternative fuel systems for cars as a hobby in the mid-1980s. By the early 2000s he was working on hydrogen extraction from water by electrolysis, and he is credited within the HHO community as the original developer of the "dry cell" electrolyser design that many later experimenters adopted. He subsequently abandoned electrolysis, saying it could never return enough fuel energy for the electrical power it consumed, and moved to a different approach.
His company H2 Global, LLC is registered in Florida and also trades online as H2GE and H4Gas. He has conducted demonstrations for accredited investors near Sarasota, Florida, and has shown a water-fuelled dune buggy on Anna Maria Island.

The World Institute for Scientific Exploration ( WISE ) is an American non-profit research organisation based in Baltimore, Maryland , incorporated in that state as a 501(c)(3) charitable corporation. Its stated purpose is to conduct and promote research on subjects that fall outside conventional funding — complementary and traditional medicine, and energy medicine in particular; new and low-cost forms of energy; consciousness and parapsychology; unidentified aerial phenomena; and unexplained phenomena generally — and to apply the results to the development of devices and services in biomedicine, energy, agriculture and the environment.
Its president and chief executive is the physician John H. Reed , who is also its treasurer.
Organisation
WISE is structured into a large number of small divisions grouped under four headings:

E.ツィオルコフスキー記念ロシア宇宙航行学アカデミ ー会員，ロシア電気工学アカデミー名誉会員，教授。航 空機搭載設備分野における 46 年間の研究実績を持ち， 航空電子工学，理論物理学，体制社会学および応用哲学 分野の多数の著書を公刊している。 著者は自然科学の未解決の問題と取り組む中で，世 界媒質――エーテル――およびエーテル風に関する A. マイケルソンその他の研究者の一次研究と出会い，そ れらの研究論文を探し出し，初めてロシア語に翻訳し た。詳細な検討を行ったところ，1881 年および 1887 年の実験の「ゼロ結果」は，その後の実験ではゼロではなかったことが判明した。その ため，著者はエーテルの存在を否定した A.アインシュタインの相対性理論の論理的・実 験的根拠について分析を行うことを余儀なくされた。 分析結果は著者をショック状態に陥れた。しかし，著者は誠実な人間として，その結 果を公表し，生じたことについて意見を表明することが自分の責務であると考えた。 ロシア自然科学アカデミー 人智圏の知識と技術部門 相対性理論の基礎に関する批判的分析 分析的概観 第2版 モスクワ 2012 年 UDC 530.3 相対性理論の基礎に関する批判的分析：分析的概観（第 2 版），モスクワ，Nauchny mir，2012 この分析的概観では，A.アインシュタインの特殊および一般相対性理論の論理的根拠， 実験設定の方法論的特徴および実験結果の解釈が検討されている。相対性理論の命題と 結論の正当性を検証するため，様々な研究者によって行われた実験の結果が分析され， その批判的評価が与えられている。 本書は A.アインシュタインの相対性理論に関する問題に関心を持つ，幅広い読者層を 対象としている。 学術出版物 本書についてのご感想，ご要望，ご注文は下記住所宛てにお送りください。 140187，モスクワ州ジュコーフスキー市ドゥーギン通り 6 番地 14 号室 Е-mail: atsuk@dart.ru. 連絡用電話番号 8-926-169-04-95 著者：ウラジーミル・アキモヴィッチ・アツュコフスキー，工学博士，ロシア自然科学 アカデミー会員，K. 2］。諸量の実践的な計算において大きな便利さをもたらしているこの単位系の長 所は，その普遍性（科学技術のすべての領域を包摂していること） ，統一性（すなわち， 比例係数を含んでおらず，そこには比例係数がまったく存在しない方程式にもとづい て作られる組立単位同士が整合していること）およびすべての次元の指数の値の整数 性である。SI 単位系は，この整数性という点で，つい最近まで電気工学の実践の場で 採用されていた CGS 静電単位系，CGS 電磁単位系およびガウス単位系とは異なってお り，これが利点となっている。後者の 3 つの単位系においては，誘電率あるいは透磁 率が抽象的な無次元の単位とみなされ，このことがそれらから物理的意味を奪ってい た。これらの単位系においては，すべての電気工学的量において，例えばg1/2 あるいは cm3/2といった分数の指数が現れている。これにはいかなる物理的意味もない。 SI 単位系の便利さにもかかわらず，質量，長さ（空間的延長）および時間のみが現 れている力学量が任意の組立量の物理的本質を容易に理解することを可能にしている のに対し，アンペア，カンデラ，ケルビンおよびモルといった基本単位においては， それらの物理的意味を直接的に見て取ることはできない。それゆえ，これら 4 つの量 が基本量のリストに含まれていることはどれだけ正当なのか，また，これらの量の物 理的本質を突きとめ，さらにそれを通じて，これらの量から組み立てられるすべての 量の物理的本質を突きとめようと試みることは正しいのかという疑問が生じてくる。 他のすべての物理量にとっての出発点となる基本量の構成の決定に際して恣意が存 在しないようにするためには，基本量の選択は，普遍的物理不変量，すなわち，絶対 的にすべての物理的な構造，現象および過程に内在しているカテゴリーにもとづいて 行う必要がある。そのようなカテゴリーであるのは， ［SI 単位系における］7 つのカテゴリ ーではなく，3 つのカテゴリー，すなわち物質*，空間および時間であることを見て取 るのは難しいことではない。なぜなら，すべての物体と構造は物質*的であり，それら すべては共通の空間の中に存在し，すべての現象と過程は時間の中で進行しているか らである。ここには例外はない。それゆえ，これらの量――物質*量の尺度としての質 量，空間の尺度としての長さおよび時間――が他のすべての物理量にとっての出発点 となる基本量となることができ，ならなければならない

search_text: ФУНДАМЕНТАЛЬНЫЕ ПРОБЛЕМЫ МЕТРОЛОГИИ В.А.Ацюковский Всеобщие физические инварианты и предложения по модернизации Международной системы единиц СИ Как известно, в процессе развития науки были созданы различные системы единиц. В настоящее время наиболее удобной системой единиц, получившей широкую проверку практикой и международное признание, является Международная система единиц СИ [1, 2]. Достоинствами этой системы, обеспечившими большие удобства в практических расчетах величин, являются ее универсальность (охватывает все отрасли науки и техники), когерентность, т. е. согласованность производных единиц, образующихся по уравнениям, не содержащим коэффициентов пропорциональности, которые в ней попросту отсутствуют, а также целочисленность значений степеней всех размерностей. Последним система СИ выгодно отличается от применявшихся совсем недавно в электротехнической практике систем СГСЕ, СГСМ и Гауссовской, в которых либо диэлектрическая проницаемость, либо магнитная проницаемость приравнивались к абстрактным безразмерным единицам, что лишало их физического смысла. В этих системах фигурируют дробные показатели у всех электротехнических величин, например, г 1/2 или см3/2, что также лишено какого бы то ни было физического смысла. Тем не менее, если механические величины, в которых фигурируют только размерности массы, длины (пространственной протяженности) и времени позволяют легко усвоить физическую сущность любой производной величины, то 1 в таких основных единицах как Ампер, кандела, градус Кельвина и моль физический смысл непосредственно не просматривается. Поэтому возникает вопрос, насколько последние четыре величины правомерно помещены в список основных величин и не правильно ли было бы попытаться установить их физическую сущность, а через это и физическую сущность всех производных от них величин. ISBN 978-5-317-0710-6 https://doi.org/10.29003/m3444.978-5-317-07010-6 ロシアの著名な科学者たちによる本書では，物理的真空，すなわちその中において あらゆる過程が進行しているある種の媒質としてのエーテルの存在という仮説を用い て，基礎的自然現象の研究に対する新たな理論的アプローチが体系的に述べられてい る。本研究では，エーテルは，一般に受け入れられている保存則，すなわち物質*およ び運動量の保存則を満たす，ある種の 1 成分連続媒質として理解されている。ファラ デーおよびマクスウェルの研究から 150 年経った今，実験的に立証されている全ての 基礎的物理法則（マクスウェル方程式，ローレンツ力，ガウスの定理，クーロンの法 則，ビオ—サバールの法則，アンペールの法則，電磁誘導の法則，オームの法則，ジュ ール—レンツの法則，ウィーデマン—フランツの法則，万有引力の法則，等々）は，こ れら 2 つの前提から数学的に導き出されることが初めて示された。これまでパラドキ シカルと思われていた多数の過程のメカニズムの詳細が解明された。 数理モデリングの方法論において採用されているモデルの根拠付けの方法は，提示 されているエーテルの数理モデルは，電磁気過程および重力過程を適切に記述してい ると結論付けることを可能にしている。 幾百もの既知のおよび新たな実験的事実に関する定性的および定量的分析は，経験 を一般化する科学としての物理学の方法論に従い，エーテル―あらゆる過程がその中 で生じている媒質―は存在するという結論を下すことを可能にしている。 本書の内容は，最近 15 年間に行われた著者らの研究作業に基づいている。多くの 結果は，初めて公表されるものである。 本書は，電気力学，電気工学，重力，運動論および連続体力学の領域の専門家，ま た， これらの科学領域の基本的な基礎に関心を持つ大学院生や学生を対象としている。 本研究は，問題検討の包括性と問題分析の深さという点でユニークなものである。 キーワード： 数理モデリング，電気と磁気，重力，運動論，連続体力学，エーテル。 ISBN 978-5-317-07010-6 © Bychkov V.L., Zaitsev F.S., 2016 © Bychkov V.L., Zaitsev F.S., 改訂部分を含む，2019 © Bychkov V.L., Zaitsev F.S., 改訂部分を含む，2023 © 装丁 LLC “MAKS Press”, 2023 3 Authors: Vladimir L. Derevenskii）という筆名を使っている。 訳者：吉田 正友（サイト： 「物理の旅の道すがら」http://naturalscience.world.coocan.jp/） 日本語版公開：2016 年 4 月 * 訳文中の角括弧［ ］内は訳注である（文献番号を除く） 。 2 海水の蓄積的噴出 A.A.グリシャエフ 全連邦物理工学・無線工学研究所時間・空間・度量衡研究所 141570 モスクワ州メンデレエボ はじめに 確実に測定された水深が 2 km 以上もある外洋で船舶が浅瀬に乗り上げた という記事が船舶関係の雑誌に掲載されることは，けっしてそれほど稀なことではない。 そのような事象が生じた後，もしその船が自力航行によって最寄りの港にたどり着けた としたら，その船は非常に運がよかったとみなすことができる。なぜなら，正体不明の 流体衝撃は，――べた凪状態の場合でさえ――船を転覆させたり，破断させたりする力 を持っているからである。これについては，この種の海難事故の生存者の数多くの証言 が存在する。正統派科学はそれらの流体衝撃の由来を説明することができず，ひたすら その存在を隠している。そのため，流体衝撃に起因する船舶や潜水艇の沈没事故や破損 事故が生じ続けている。 本論文では，垂直方向への海水の蓄積的噴出［vertical cumulative ejection of ocean water］の本 質的な発生メカニズムが記述され，また，その種の噴出の形成から生じるいくつかの帰 結――特に，津波の発生――が検討される。 海底火山は海の放水銃である。 海水の蓄積的噴出は，環太平洋火山帯その他の地帯 の中央海嶺の上で，すなわち海底の地震活動や火山活動が活発な海域において生じる。 海底火山のドームが海流に洗われてかなりの程度まで浸食され，崩壊した後，何が生 じるかについて検討してみよう。海水が火山の空洞内に勢いよく流れ込み，これに伴い， ベルヌーイの方程式に従って水流の中で動的圧力低下が生じる。海水層中における新た な圧力場の構造は，かつてドームであった領域から音速で伝播する擾乱によって決定さ れる。その擾乱が，空洞内への海水の流入が止まるより前に，擾乱源の真上に位置する 最近傍地点の海水面だけでなく，擾乱源を中心とするある円内の海水面にも到達するこ とができたとしよう。この場合，海水面上で始まる水流の流線は，垂直方向の共通の対 称軸を持つ上に開いた複数のじょうごの形状を持つ，形成される複数の回転図形に沿っ て配置される。このとき，動的圧力低下によって条件づけられる圧力勾配の方向は，そ れらの漏斗の表面に対する法線に沿って中心軸の側に向かっている。このように，じょ うご形の領域が形成され，その内部の各レベルでは，圧力が周縁から中心軸に向かって 低下している。そして，そのような圧力分布はその領域内における水流によって条件づ けられている。それゆえ，その水流が止まるやいなや，中心軸に向かって収縮する波に よって圧力の均等化が生じ，その波が蓄積的噴出を生み出す。 この噴出が海面上に上昇する高さを大雑把に推定するため，この課題は，連通管に関 する次の課題と同等であることを指摘しておきたい。下部が仕切り板で仕切られている U 字管の各曲がり管部に，密度の異なる混じり合わない液体が注入されている。なお， それらの液体の液柱の高さは同一である。また，ここで知ろうとしているのは，仕切り 板を取り去った後，より低密度の側の液体はいかなる高さまで上昇するのかということ である。類推を完全なものとするため，流出する流れの中における動的圧力低下は，形 式的には，――それに正比例する密度低下による――静的圧力低下の結果とみなすこと ができるということ

В судовых журналах не так уж редки записи о том, что судно налетало на мель в открытом океане, где достоверно измеренная глубина составляет 2 км и более. Если после такого происшествия судно своим ходом добиралось до ближайшего порта, то можно считать, что ему крупно повезло. Ведь таинственные гидроудары – даже при полном штиле – способны опрокидывать или переламывать корабли, о чём имеется множество свидетельств тех, кто выжил в такого рода морских катастрофах. Официальная наука, бессильная объяснить происхождение этих гидроударов, их просто замалчивает – а корабли и подводные лодки продолжают от них гибнуть. В настоящей статье описан природный механизм возникновения вертикального кумулятивного выброса океанской воды, а также рассмотрены некоторые следствия образования такого выброса – в частности, рождение цунами. Подводные вулканы – гидро-пушки Океана. Кумулятивные выбросы воды происходят над срединно-океаническими хребтами, в зоне Тихоокеанского «горячего кольца», и т.п. – т.е. в тех районах океана, где дно сейсмически и вулканически активно. Рассмотрим, что происходит после того, как свод подводного вулкана проплавляется в достаточной степени и обрушивается. Вода устремляется в вулканическую каверну и, согласно уравнению Бернулли, это сопровождается динамическим падением давления в потоке. Установление новой картины давления в водной толще происходит с помощью возмущения, распространяющегося от области бывшего свода со скоростью звука. Пусть до того, как вода перестанет поступать в каверну, это возмущение успеет достигнуть поверхности океана не только в ближайшей точке, расположенной прямо над источником возмущения, но и в некотором круге с центром в этой точке. Derevenskii）という筆名を使っている。 訳者：吉田 正友（サイト： 「物理の旅の道すがら」http://naturalscience.world.coocan.jp/） 日本語版公開：2016 年 4 月 * 訳文中の角括弧［ ］内は訳注である（文献番号を除く） 。 2 孤立巨大波の発生とこれに対する受動的防御 A.A.グリシャエフ 全連邦物理工学・無線工学研究所時間・空間度量衡研究所 141570 モスクワ州メンデレエボ 古来，船乗りたちは海洋における高さ 20 ~ 30 m の恐るべき孤立波について語ってき た。そのような波は凪の状態でも突然発生し，船に襲いかかって船体を破損させ，ある いは海底に送り込む。最近まで，アカデミズム科学はそのような出来事の科学的説明が 存在しないという理由で，生き残った目撃者たちの話を信じようとはしなかった。しか し，巨大波現象の研究に対して研究資金が割り当てられるようになった現在では，この 問題に対する科学的アプローチは根本的に変化した。マスメディアの報道記事は「殺人 波［訳注］が獲物を求めて海を徘徊している！」と叫び立てている。 ところで，次の点を明確にしておきたい。巨大波を目撃した船乗りたちは，その波が 海原をうろつき回っているのを見たなどとは，けっして語っていない。目撃者たちの 様々な証言は次の 1 点において一致している。すなわち，巨大波は船のすぐ近傍で盛り 上がり，船に襲いかかった後，ただちに消え失せる。「あの波がどこから姿を現したの かも，どこに姿を隠したのかもわからない」――これこそが巨大波と遭遇した者が語っ ていることなのである。 時間と場所を異にする多数の目撃者の話を信じない根拠を我々は持っていない以上， すべてはまさにそのように生じているとみなすことにしよう。そうであるならば，この 現象を説明する上で，例えば孤立巨大波の発生は風波同士の干渉，あるいは潮流同士の 衝突と関係を持っているとするモデルは，我々にとって不要となる。我々の見解によれ ば，これらのモデルは不自然である。それとは逆に，孤立巨大波の発生は，我々の津波 に関する理解［1］にもとづいて自然に説明することができる。 その理解によれば，津波を生み出す波は表面波ではなく，水層中を伝播する圧力差の 波［以下「圧力波」という］である（ ［2］も参照のこと）。そのような波の波源は，十分に 強力な局所的な圧力上昇――例えば水中爆発，海底地震，あるいは急激な水位上昇，特 に狭隘なフィヨルド内における崖崩れ，あるいは海水の蓄積的噴出［1］に伴う局所的 な圧力上昇――である。 ［1］で指摘されているように，圧力波の波面はいわゆるニュー トンの音速，すなわち c= (P/)1/2 = [(Patm+gd)/]1/2 （1） で運動する［3］ 。ここで P は擾乱を受けていない水中の圧力， は水の密度，Patm は大 気圧，g は自由落下運動の加速度，d はそれに関して速度が決定される深度である。こ の式から見て取れるように，速度 c は深度に依存しており，波面の海底近傍区域がそれ 以外のすべての区域と比べて最も大きな速度で運動する。大洋の大水深の場合，公式（1） における大気圧の寄与は無視することができる。大洋の水深が D のとき，波面の海底 近傍区域は速度(gD)1/2 で運動する。この値は，津波を発生させる事象から海岸への第 1 波衝突までの時間間隔の多数の測定値とよく一致している。ところで，第 1 波衝突はま さに底波によってもたらされていることを示す，多数の証拠が存在する。例えば，津波 の通過後に自分がよく知っている場所

search_text: 1 ПРОИСХОЖДЕНИЕ ОДИНОЧНЫХ ГИГАНТСКИХ ВОЛН И ПАССИВНАЯ ЗАЩИТА ОТ НИХ А.А.Гришаев Государственный эталон времени-частоты, ФГУП «ВНИИФТРИ» 141570 Московская обл., Менделеево Издавна моряки рассказывают о страшных одиночных волнах в океане, высотой до 20-30 м. Такая волна, случается, внезапно возникает даже при штиле и обрушивается на корабль – повреждая его или отправляя на дно. До последнего времени академическая наука не верила рассказам выживших очевидцев – ввиду отсутствия научных объяснений происходящего. Но теперь, когда на изучение феномена гигантских волн стали выделяться средства, научный подход к проблеме кардинально изменился. «Океаны бороздят волны-убийцы!» - кричат сообщения в средствах массовой информации. Между тем, следует уточнить: моряки-очевидцы гигантских волн рассказывают отнюдь не о том, что будто бы видели эти волны гуляющими по океану. Свидетельства очевидцев сходятся в одном: гигантская волна вздымается в непосредственной близости от корабля и обрушивается на него, а затем сразу пропадает. «Непонятно, откуда она взялась, и непонятно, куда она делась» - вот что говорят про неё те, кто имели с ней встречу. Будем считать, что всё происходит именно так – поскольку у нас нет оснований не доверять рассказам многочисленных очевидцев, разделённых во времени и в пространстве. Тогда для объяснения феномена нам не потребуются модели, в которых происхождение одиночных гигантских волн связывается, например, с интерференцией ветровых волн или со столкновением течений – эти модели, на наш взгляд, неправдоподобны. Напротив, возникновение одиночных гигантских волн естественно объясняется на основе наших представлений [1] о цунами. 又どうかすると、三月も半年も血液型と気質が話題にもならず忘れ去られたようになった りしながら、十数年を過した。あの人は何型らしいといった時あたり易い人とそうでない 人、何型らしいと思っても百%あてることはむずかしいということ、何度も何度も失敗し た末に、個人が相手の血液型を想定する場合、一定の法則があるような気がしてきた。つ まりある人がどういう気質をもっているという場合、その人を云々する批評者の血液型が 問題になるということを発見した。それから、私等の血液型は、古川竹二教授の血液型と 気質説から、人間関係学、或いは関係的人間学という学説の理論追究に進み、今日漸く仮 説として発表するところまで達した。発表までには、かなりの間があったので、Rh 胎児、 交通事故、輸血、血液不足に関連して、血液型の知識も一般化され、血液型に関する本も 二、三出た。もしかしたら他の「血液型と気質」が世に出るのではないかと注意もしてい たが、あれほど話題に機敏な週刊誌にも、「血液型と気質説」は、ほんのひとことも出な かった。一方、私たちが話す気質と血液型の理論に興味を持つ友人、学生たちは忘れずに、 そのあとの話を聞かせて下さいといった。こうしたことで多少自信を持ち、印刷に付した いと願ったのであるが、たまたま、出版・印刷会社の経営をしている親友の今井澄夫氏の 援助を得て、私家版として出版の運びになった。同氏に対して厚く謝意を表したい。なお、 研究の途中から、筆者の教え子で国立大学の学生Ｓ君が協力者として加わった。その研究 成果も併せて載せた次第である。 目黒 宏次 4 序 今日ほど西欧の合理主義が、科学において成功を示し、社会科学の分野において危機に 頻しているときはないであろう。合理主義はその窮極の目標が、人間性の開発を指向して いるにもかかわらず、結果は同じ文化の名のもとに画一化し、かえって人間疎外をまねい たのである。そのたびに人類は新しい模索をつづけ、個我へ、生命の秘密へ肉迫するので ある。血液型と気質の相関の問題もまさにかようなものである。ひとは人と人との対応に おいて、共通の法則によって貫かれるのではないか、化学物質である血液体液が対人間関 係の変化において、どのように適応するのであるか、又その情報をどのようにしてうけと るのであるか、従来の人間行動への社会心理学的なアプローチに対し、一層核心にせまる ものをもっているのではないか、古川学説を継承し、更に大胆な仮説として提出したもの である。 東洋においては、ABO 式の各血液型者はほぼ平均して存在し、西欧社会の AO 型社会と 異なったアジア社会を形成する。このことも、異常なほどに東洋の問題に関心を向けはじ めた西欧の人々の注目をひくものであることを確信する。 ㈱スリーライト社長 今井 澄夫 5 目 次 第一部 歴史編 ― 古川学説の紹介と批判 search_text: С.В.Пантюхов А-Газ 1  Н m   м 2  P 1  R  TA Е  mc 2  m   m 0  m  A  PA  V A  MA 0   0 A  кг  0  3   м  и система классификации физических величин Москва 2012 1 Аннотация. Выполнена, в общем-то, простая и формальная работа, основанная на доверии к физической интуиции и к особому, целостному мироощущению великих физиков прошлых столетий: размерности физических величин из раздела электричества и магнетизма выражены через килограмм, метр и секунду системы СИ. Такое выражение размерностей позволило построить систему классификации физических величин, и представить её в виде таблицы, где 340 величин из различных разделов физики собраны в общих ячейках по признаку одинаковых значений их размерностей. Введено понятие А-Газа, тождественного всепроникающей «газоподобной среде», параметры и свойства которой впервые были описаны В.А.Ацюковским. search_text: 1 V.L.ヤンチリン 不確定性・重力・宇宙 第2版 モスクワ URSS 2 ［本書の裏表紙に掲載されている書評］ 「ワシーリー・レオニードヴィッチ・ヤンチリンの量子重力理論は，まさに生まれたば かりであるにもかかわらず，その結果はきわめて根本的であり，しかもきわめて単純明快 に叙述されているため，本書における彼の主要な着想を真似したいという誘惑を自制する のが困難なほどであった。このことは，量子情報理論をテーマとしている章の題材全体を 読者が理解することをより大きな期待をもって予想することを可能にしているだけに，な おさら適切なことであると思われる。 V.L.ヤンチリンの理論においては，基礎物理学の次の 3 つの問題を解決する試みが成功 裡になされている： ・マッハの原理を説明すること。 ・粒子と波動の二重性を説明すること。 ・重力相互作用を説明すること。 」 レヴォリト・ポロンニコフ［Revold Polonnikov］ （ロシア科学アカデミーサンクトペ テルブルク情報自動化研究所主任研究員， 工学博士，教授， ロシア連邦国家賞受賞者） 。 R.I.ポロンニコフ著『一般情報理論の基本コンセプト』 （サンクトペテルブルク，2006） より引用。 「現在， 量子物理学の枠内で重力を記述する， すなわち量子重力理論を創出する試みは， 今のところ成功していない。このような状況において，ワシーリー・ヤンチリンによって 開発されているあまり知られていない着想は，疑いもなく興味を引く。 」 ウラジーミル・クズネツォフ［Vladimir Kuznetsov］ （ロシア科学アカデミー極東支部 宇宙物理学・電波伝播研究所主任研究員，工学博士，教授） 。 サイト http://vvk.personal.ikir.ru より引用。 「それだけでなく，量子重力理論に関する V.L.ヤンチリンの研究において示されている ように，量子力学的カオスは，宇宙全体にとって，事実上“周囲媒質”の機能を果たして いる。なぜなら，プランク定数は，宇宙の質量から遠ざかるにつれて，重力ポテンシャル の減少を伴いつつ，無限に増大するからである。我々の宇宙は，あたかもそれを取り囲む 量子力学的カオスの中に沈んでいるかのようであり，その中では空間および時間それ自体 が物理的意味を失う。 このきわめて重要な結論は，全体としての宇宙が持っている半分開いているという性格 を我々に説明してくれる。この性格のおかげで，宇宙においては情報現象，また，その中 で情報の生成（増大）が生じる発展過程が可能となる。 」 ユーリー・マルコフ［Yuri Markov］ （ロシア科学アカデミーシベリア支部哲学・法学 研究所，哲学博士，教授） 。 Yu.G.マルコフ著『情報増大の法則と安定的発展の問題』 （ノヴォシビスルク，2005） より引用。 3 LBC 22.382о 22.312 22.632 V.L.ヤンチリン 『不確定性・重力・宇宙』 ，第 2 版，モスクワ，Editorial URSS，2009, 248 p. (Relata Refero) 本書では，新たな理論―量子重力理論―の基礎が叙述されている。重力相互作用が，初 めて，もっぱら量子効果とみなされている。量子力学の新たな解釈が提唱され，時空が大 質量の近傍において曲がる理由が説明されている。新たな理論の検証に関する簡単な実験 の記述が示されている。 査読者： S.E.シュノリ教授（M.V.ロモノーソフ記念モスクワ国立大学物理学部） ISBN 978–5–354–01186–5 © V.L. Zaitsev E.マッハの空間に関するコンセプトの理念に則って物理学的命題を定式化する試みがな された。提案されている定式化における「マッハの原理」を満たすモデルを用いて，太陽 に近い惑星の「ポスト古典的」近日点移動の値が決定された。重力理論のための新たな試 験方法が提唱されている。 目 次 1. 序論 …………………………………………………………………………… 2 2.「マッハの基準」…………………………………………………………… 4 3. 重力相互作用する物体のエネルギーと質量 ……………… 5 4. 物体の全ポテンシャルエネルギーと静止エネルギー の物理的意味 …………………………………………………………… 7 5.「マッハの原理」の内容の精緻化について ………………… 7 6. 計量曲率と「ニュートン」曲率について …………………… 8 7. 軌道安定性の問題に寄せて ……………………………………… 11 8. ポスト古典的近日点移動の原因 ……………………………… 12 9. 結論 …………………………………………………………………………… 15 文献一覧 ………………………………………………………………………… 17 ［訳注］訳文中の「物質*」について ……………………………… 19 1.序論 普通， 「進歩」という言葉は，包括的な意味では物的手段（技術的手段，機器）の発達を 意味している。結局のところ，技術的側面こそが科学の基盤をなし，情報の蓄積，更新お よび普及を保障している。 応用科学および高度技術の領域における疑う余地のない成功は，個人の意識の中で，高 度の教養が考えられないほどの偏見と葛藤なしに共存することを可能にするような人的因 子に対し，影響を及ぼす力を持っていない。 ［一人の人間の中で］ある方面における並外れた能 力が別の方面における完全な無力さと組み合わさっているということは，例外ではなく， むしろ法則である。 基礎科学の発展は人間の脳が産出するアイデアから生まれるが，その脳は，進化の過程 で完璧な分析作業のために準備されたものではない。客観的知識の境界は，あらゆる幻想 に反し，実験事実および観測事実の限界によって区切られている。それらの限界（基礎科 学およびサイエンス・フィクションの排他的領域）の外では，主観的因子が決定的となる。 現代的観点の文脈の中で見ると，現実の反映に含まれている矛盾は，おそらく 200 年前， 500 年前，あるいは 2000 年前と比べてより少ないというわけではない。 相対論的物理学，重力物理学，宇宙起源論および宇宙論といった基礎科学の応用領域に は，超過激な A.アインシュタインの思想が浸透している。彼が現代人や追随者の知性に与 えた影響と比較可能なのは，おそらく，自分と同じほど有能だが成功には至らなかった同 3 僚たちを凌駕し，自分の思想の地位を「究極の真理」のレベルにまで高めたアリストテレ スの影響のみであろう。この比較がどれだけ正しいかの評価は，より情報量の多い我々の 子孫によって与えられることであろう。 一般相対性理論として知られているアインシュタインの重力理論は，今日にいたるまで 現代物理学において排他的地位を占めている。本論文の範囲内では，我々は一般相対性理 論の出発点をなす諸原理，エネルギー・運動量保存および補外法の問題に関する議論は差 し控える。これら全ての問題は該当する文献で考察されている。観測データに対する理論 の一致という事項にのみ注意を払おう。なぜなら，これが本論文のテーマと直接関連して

Zaitsev 保存則に基づいて一連の思考実験の一貫性に関する分析がなされた。その結果，いわゆ る「重力定数」𝐺は，全重力ポテンシャルの値に関数的に依存する係数であることが判明し た。𝐺の値の相対的変化は，全重力ポテンシャルの相対的変化の 3 乗に反比例しているこ とが突きとめられた。 目 次 第 I 部 ………………………………………………………………………………………………… 2 1. 導入 ……………………………………………………………………………………… 2. エレベーターキャビン中における「エネルギーのパラドッ クス」について …………………………………………………………………… 3 3. 全重力ポテンシャルの関数としての物体の質量………………… 4 4. 全重力ポテンシャルの関数としての時間間隔と空間間隔 … 5 5. 全重力ポテンシャルの関数としての重力係数 …………………… 7 6. 第 I 部の結論 ………………………………………………………………………… 9 第 II 部 ………………………………………………………………………………………………… 11 1. 運動質量理論の基礎．ポスト相対論的アプローチ …………… 11 2. 光子の場合のドップラー効果．ポストニュートン係数．絶対 速度の関数として重力係数 ………………………………………………… 13 3. 結論部 ………………………………………………………………………………… 18 文献一覧 ……………………………………………………………………………………………… 21 記号 …………………………………………………………………………………………………… 22 用語と定義 ………………………………………………………………………………………… 22 ［訳注］訳文中の「物質*」について ……………………………………………… 25 第I部 I.1.導入 「重力定数」𝐺は，歴史的には一連の基礎物理量の中で最初に現れた量である。そして， その数値を決定する試みがなされたのは 3 世紀以上前のことであるにもかかわらず，測定 精度はそれでもなお比較的低いままとなっている［1］ 。 𝐺の値の精緻化の問題を測定方法の欠陥という観点の範囲外に引き出そうという意見が 存在する。𝐺は「宇宙」時間の経過とともに単調に減少するという予想［2］ ； 𝐺は世界質 量の総体によって創出される「重力背景」の値に依存している可能性があるという予想［3, 4］ （ここでは，予想される依存性は反比例の形を持っている）が述べられている。これら の理解は現在にいたるまで満足すべき根拠によって裏付けられていないという点に，特に 注目するべきである。これらの理解が持つ思弁的性格が，当然のことながら，これらの理 解に基づいて得られるかもしれない，それに続く結果に対する信頼度を低下させている。 3 本研究の目標は，𝐺の値の性格という部分に関して，直観的・主観的な判断をより厳密な 形式的論拠に置き換えるための根拠の探求である。全重力ポテンシャルの値に対する𝐺の 依存性の可能性に関するより十全な理解を得る試みがなされた。一連の思考実験に関する エネルギー保存則に基づく分析が主要な研究方法として選ばれた。 全重量ポテンシャルに対する𝐺の関数的依存性は，2 つの段階を経て突きとめることが できる。第 1 段階では，重力相互作用に関与する諸物体の質量変化が生じるのか否か

search_text: COVER IMAGE: Solid state nuclear track detector image from 2007 LENR experiment at SPAWAR. Photo: P. Mosier-Boss. See page 854. In This Issue Low energy nuclear reaction Cold fusion, as the press initially called the discovery by electrochemists Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons, is now recognized more precisely as low energy nuclear reaction (LENR) research. It has been the target of mockery, derision and doubt for many years. Some of it has been deserved, most of it not. Accumulating a rigorous body of evidence has taken 19 years, and on page 854, Steven B. Krivit reviews a broad spectrum of some of the field’s best research and key historical facts. Some of these facts were known very early in the field’s history but were difficult to see because of the chaos and confusion at the time. LENR research is no longer merely a test tube filled with heavy water, but a wide-ranging set of approaches and phenomena that arise from experiments with deuterium or hydrogen in roomtemperature conditions. The data show anomalous energy production, transmutations of heavy elements, nuclear products and emissions, and a variety of other anomalous observations. LENR methods often use only a few watts of power for their input – yet produce reactions previously exclusive to the domain of high-energy physics. The phenomena do not belong to the field of chemistry or physics but to a novel field now recognized as condensed matter nuclear science. The work speaks for itself and promises to be a reference source - perhaps of historical significance. I would like to offer a few comments and corrections on two chapters of your Special Report in the interest of factual accuracy, so that your readers can judge for themselves: 1) Chapter 1 - Pages 15 and 16 You correctly cite the need for nuclear "ash" from conventional fusion (being neutrons and comparable amount of tritium), then suggest calling bubble fusion anomalous reactions, based on the report of Dan Shapira and Michael Saltmarsh from Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL). This characterization is incorrect for the following reasons: - Shapira and Saltmarsh did not measure for tritium for that single one-hour data acquisition with cavitation on. Per my records, on July 21, 2001, Shapira visited my laboratory at ORNL to acquire data. Saltmarsh was not present. Shapira spent one hour obtaining neutron-gamma-sonoluminescence data for an experiment involving neutron-induced cavitation with deuterated acetone. This was followed with another hour obtaining similar data with cavitation turned off. Shapira did not obtain data related to tritium for the experiments of that day. The review presents some of the reasons why the subject of "cold fusion" was viewed as a mistake and why it now is recognized as a legitimate science. This update includes the broad array of nuclear ash and effects observed in LENR research, as well as the brief details of a reproducible experiment. A model that may explain the effects not as fusion or fission, but based on weak interactions is reviewed. 1 Keywords cold fusion, low energy nuclear reactions, condensed matter nuclear science, Fleischmann, Pons, palladium, deuterium, electrolysis The Problematic History of Cold Fusion Cold fusion is the popular term for the field of research that originated from an electrolysis experiment using the elements palladium (a heavy metal) and deuterium (an isotope of hydrogen). The experiment was first performed by Dr. Martin Fleischmann and Dr. Stanley Pons at the University of Utah in 1984, although related work had been performed as early as 1920. Fleischmann and Pons claimed an electrochemical method of generating nuclear energy, in a way that was previously unrecognized by nuclear physicists. content_preview: Review of Adamenko Book by Thomas Dolan, University of Illinois New Energy Times, issue #32, July, 2009 ”Controlled Nucleosynthesis, Breakthroughs in Experiment
search_text: Review of Adamenko Book by Thomas Dolan, University of Illinois New Energy Times, issue #32, July, 2009 ”Controlled Nucleosynthesis, Breakthroughs in Experiment and Theory,” Stanislav Adamenko (Editor), Franco Selleri (Editor), Alwyn van der Merwe (Editor), Springer Verlag, Dordrecht, The Netherlands, 2007. ISBN-13: 978-1402058738 This book describes a series of revolutionary experiments conducted at the Proton-21 Laboratory, Kiev, Ukraine, during 2000-2006, in which they measured nuclear transmutations induced by impact of a relativistic electron beam (REB). Chapters 1-3 discuss the history of the experiments, concepts of nucleosynthesis, and the experimental procedure. When the researchers focus a fast-rising REB onto the hemispherical end of a cylindrical metallic anode target (Cu, Fe, Pb, …) they see evidence of an explosion from the center of the anode hemisphere that peels away the metal and deposits debris on a nearby collecting plate. Chapters 4-6 describe measurements of optical and x-ray spectra and fast particles emitted by the explosion. From the intensities of optical spectra they estimated the energy yield of the ionic component of the exploding plasma to be ~ 2 kJ (much greater than the REB energy of 300 J). They find spectra of elements that were not present in the original target or collecting plate. The spectra of X-ray emissions from 10 keV to 4 MeV are similar in shape to those of a pulsar, a quasar, and a gamma burst. Using CR-39 detectors and a Thomson mass spectrometer they found that the energy spectrum of fast ions decreases almost exponentially from 0.1 to 0.7 MeV, plus a slight peak at energies > 0.8 MeV, including some protons > 1 MeV. I have tried to approach this broadly — I don’t agree with all of these myself, but this is my view of the complaints that come up over and over again. Wikipedia contains incorrect, misleading, and biased information. Whether through vandalism, subtle disinformation, or the prolonged battling over biased accounts, many of Wikipedia’s articles are unsuitable for scholarly use. Because of poor standards of sourcing and citation, it is often difficult to determine the origin of statements made in Wikipedia in order to determine their correctness. search_text: Mail Review Charge Letter Enclosed is the summary document and appendix material related to the review of recent scientific reports of low energy nuclear reactions (LENR) in metal matrices, currently being conducted for the Office of Science by the Offices of Basic Energy Sciences and Nuclear Physics in the Department of Energy on the recent scientific reports of Low Energy Nuclear Reactions (LENR). The goal of the review will be to generate a report on the status of the research field for the Director and the Principal Deputy Director of the Office of Science. The report will be written by DOE federal staff based on the individual inputs from members of a DOE empanelled review team. In your evaluation of the enclosed material, we request that you focus your comments on the overall scientific case for the existence of anomalous nuclear effects in condensed matter. In particular, we request that you: Evaluate the experimental evidence presented for the occurrences of nuclear reactions in condensed matter at low energies (less than a few electron volts) Determine whether the evidence is sufficiently conclusive to demonstrate that such nuclear reactions occur. Determine whether there is a scientific case for continued efforts in these studies and, if so, to identify the most promising areas to be pursued. Please confirm that you have received this e-mail and are able to read the associated attachments. We would appreciate receiving your review by August 19, 2004, in advance of the panel review which will be held on August 23-24, 2004. search_text: December 1, 2004 Report of the Review of Low Energy Nuclear Reactions Introduction The Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science (SC) was approached in late 2003 by a group of scientists who requested that the Department revisit the question of scientific evidence for low energy nuclear reactions. In 1987 Pons and Fleischman first reported the production of “excess” heat in a Pd electrochemical cell, and postulated that this was due to D-D fusion (D=deuterium), sometimes referred to as “cold fusion.” The work was reviewed in 1989 by the Energy Research Advisory Board (ERAB) of the DOE. ERAB did not recommend the establishment of special programs within DOE devoted to the science of low energy fusion, but supported funding of peer-reviewed experiments for further investigations. Since 1989, research programs in cold fusion have been supported by various universities, private industry, and government agencies in several countries. Review and Process In response to the above request, the Office of Science agreed to a peer review of the experimental data and supporting theory since the 1989 ERAB review. The scientists who made this request were asked to generate a review document that identified the most significant experimental observations and publications, and those areas where additional work would appear to be warranted. This document, entitled “New Physical Effects in Metal Deuterides,” was prepared by Professor Peter Hagelstein of MIT, Dr. Michael McKubre of SRI International, Professor David Nagel of George Washington University, Dr. Talbot Chubb of Research Systems Inc., and Mr. Randall Hekman of Hekman Industries (hereafter referred to as the proposers). search_text: Summary Of The Third Annual Conference on Cold Fusion By Peter Hagelstein Massachusetts Institute of Technology Research Laboratory of Electronics Cambridge, Massachusetts 02139 Abstract We review highlights of the international cold fusion conference that was held recently in Nagoya, Japan. Excess heat results in heavy water electrolysis experiments constitute the observations with the most important potential applications. Experiments in gas phase systems exhibit fast particle and gamma emission that make progress toward elucidating mechanisms. The evidence in support of a light water heat effect has improved. Introduction The Third International Cold Fusion Conference took place in Nagoya, Japan between October 21 and October 25, 1992. Over 300 attendees participated, listening to about 27 oral presentations and looking over roughly 80 poster papers. Many people have asked me about the conference, and rather than repeating the same things over and over again, I thought that it would be useful to put my thoughts down on paper as a more efficient method of communication. Given the near complete absence of cold fusion sessions in more traditional physics and chemistry meetings, the international conferences represent about the only chance for people in the cold fusion field to get together and learn about what has happened lately. The international conferences, starting with the Salt Lake City conference in 1990, followed by Como, Italy in 1991, and now Nagoya, Japan in 1992, have been and continue to be the most important sources of reliable and relevant information in the field; an important meeting was also held at BYU in 1990 which focused on nuclear products. search_text: Discussion of Low-Energy Nuclear Reactions 413 The Big Picture of Low-Energy Nuclear Reaction Research Steven B. Krivit Senior Editor, New Energy Times, 369-B Third Street, Suite 556, San Rafael, CA, 94901, net@newenergytimes.com INTRODUCTION This paper is part of the panel session "Discussion of Low-Energy Nuclear Reactions." This paper will introduce, and for some people re-introduce, the topic of low-energy nuclear reaction research. LENR research shows a surprising variety of nuclear phenomena and nuclear energy release at or near room-temperature and pressure without the need for high-energy physics or radioactive starting materials. Significant foundational work on this topic dates to the 1920s. The modern era of this field began in 1989 when electrochemists B. Stanley Pons and Martin Fleischmann announced that they had overcome the Coulomb barrier at room temperature and triggered nuclear fusion. It turns out they didn't discover "cold fusion," but they did extend the earlier work and make some significant discoveries, even if, at the time of their announcement, they didn't understand the underlying physics. The next significant phase in the field occurred between 1996 and 2006. During this time, experimental findings emerged to show that, although the set of phenomena is indeed nuclear, it has little or nothing to do with fusion. In 2006, Lewis Larsen and Allan Widom clarified the matter when they published a groundbreaking theory that explains the experimental LENR findings as weak interactions coupled with neutron-capture processes, without the need to invoke "new physics" or miracles.[1] Based on the latest theoretical insights and experimental findings, LENRs
